name: Coralveil Epic Gear
blurb: Epic gear: jewel-toned brocade, engraved plate accents, ornate borders and enamel-trimmed leather gear bearing an original jellyfish stitch badge. Amethyst and iridescent teal panels, beaded scallops, flowing tentacle embroidery and opal-colored trim. Intended as an epic item alternative for the amethyst palette.
